reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 19. Nay or No: 21. Not Voting: 0. It was great to meet with @AutismSpeaks advocates to discuss how Congress can better support caregivers and people living with autism.

Right now, many caregivers are struggling to access the proper Social Security benefits that will allow them to continue supporting people living with autism. For the caregivers across our communities and those in their care, we have a duty to close these gaps.

posts.text:
Hunter syndrome affects thousands of people and it’s critical that Congress commits to properly researching treatments for this disease.

I am introducing a resolution recognizing this week as National Hunter Syndrome Awareness Week to reaffirm our commitment to supporting those living with this progressive disorder, and our commitment to finding a cure.

Read more: https://t.co/2yvgx9zfhZ

I was grateful for the opportunity to join @NCDOT’s announcement that our state will be receiving $550 million to advance the Raleigh to Wake Forest segment of the S-line passenger rail.

Passenger rail expansion in our state and across the northeast corridor is long overdue—I will continue to explore all routes in Congress to further support the S-Line and transit expansion across North Carolina.

I had the pleasure of meeting with @GoTriangle’s Interim President Katharine Eggleston to discuss ways we can better support transit expansion across the Triangle region.

Our area is expected to continue the steep population growth that we have seen over the last decade, and we need to be equipped with the proper public transit options that will keep our communities connected.

It was great to meet with @OrangeHabitat to learn more the work they are doing to support housing access across our community including a tour of their upcoming Auman Village development.

In Congress, I will never stop working to ensure proper access to housing for every single American and I am grateful to see so many local organizations who are supporting our community in that fight.

Yesterday, I joined the friends, family, and loved ones of Isaac Gallegos alongside the rest of our community in calling for Isaac’s release from ICE detention.

There is no reason that Isaac should have been separated from his family. ICE must release him immediately, and we must put an end to this inhumane agency.

📣 ICYMI: The deadline to apply for my Youth Advisory Council is tomorrow, October 16th at 5:00PM!

This is an opportunity for high school students to engage in public policy, learn how Congress works, and serve your community. To learn more, visit: https://t.co/Oq7B50WM3t

Yesterday, I stopped by a social studies class at @CulbrethCougars where I had a long discussion with students about their concerns surrounding data centers and the current political climate.

These students are the future leaders of our country—it is always a privilege to hear directly from them about what they hope to see from Congress.

I was grateful for the opportunity to join HOPE NC's Weavers Grove development ribbon cutting ceremony.

While housing prices skyrocket across the country, I'm grateful to see local organizations help fill-in the gaps and will continue to fight for proper housing reform in Congress.

Thank you to all the students who participated in my and @RepDeborahRoss’ Congressional App Challenge Jumpstarter! Submissions for the 2026 @CongressionalAC are still open until October 26! To register, visit https://t.co/HM8nrOvCyz. https://t.co/M3tU5nOcqO

Congratulations to @NCSSM graduate @Astro_Christina on your promotion to Acting Deputy Chief Engineer for @NASA! You have already inspired generations of Americans, and I can’t wait to see everything you accomplish in this new role leading NASA’s engineering community.

https://t.co/XGXnk7gUHq

Russia continuing to target Ukrainian power facilities just hours after Trump announced a so-called energy infrastructure ceasefire further shows that this Administration is not holding Putin accountable.

Innocent lives are at risk—this cannot be tolerated. https://t.co/h1d0mNyLzE

I am cosponsoring @JoaquinCastroTX’s Stop the Settlements Act to enact mandatory sanctions on anyone involved with Israel’s settler expansion in the West Bank or Gaza, and ban imports from Israeli settlements.

These land grabs and the continued destruction of Palestinian property are unacceptable and do not advance attempts to achieve peace. These actions are forcefully displacing innocent civilians from their homes and will only lead to further violence in the region.

It was my pleasure to join @DukeU's summit on AI for health innovation!

AI holds potential to greatly improve health outcomes and medical research, but we can only achieve those successes with responsible innovation and regulations to protect our communities. https://t.co/DuHdKBQ8BK

Trump's weaponizing of the DOJ against Congresswoman Omar is completely unprecedented and unacceptable. This raid is yet another brazenly racist attempt to silence his political opponents while he demonizes Somali Americans, immigrant communities, and people of color across the country.

We must all stand strong alongside Congresswoman Omar in the face of tyranny.

ICE's detention of Isaac Gallegos must end immediately. ICE is not an agency focused on public safety, it is an agency that seeks to strike fear into our community and split families apart.

We must continue to fight for passage of legislation to completely dismantle and defund this agency which has no place in our country.

It was great to join @PiedmontHealth_ for a tour of their Pittsboro PACE Center to learn more about how Congress can better support comprehensive medical services for older adults.

As we continue to fight for the passage of Medicare for All, I’ll continue exploring all routes to support our local healthcare facilities and ensure they can continue providing quality care to our communities.

I am keeping the family and loved ones of firefighter Andrew Brokes in my prayers during this difficult time. Andrew dedicated his career to protecting North Carolinians, and today he made the ultimate sacrifice in the line of duty.

We will not forget Andrew Brokes's service and sacrifice, and our community owes him a debt of gratitude.

It was great to visit Rose Manor Health and Rehab in Durham to learn more about their efforts to provide comprehensive care to residents across our communities.

While Republicans make cuts to Medicare and put hospitals at risk, I’ll keep fighting for our local medical facilities and ensure they have the support they need.

It was great to join @JHSFalcons AP Government students for a discussion on the inner workings of government and Congress. These bright students are the future of our nation, and I cannot wait to see how far they will go! https://t.co/DzPMcqJ0bE
Read more: https://t.co/RJgDjrK6CC

The withholding of Teen Pregnancy Prevention grants by @HHSgov from schools like @DukeU is another attempt to divert funds obligated by Congress away from programs that help our communities, and into the pockets of this Administration.

I am demanding that @SecKennedy explain these attempts to cancel important health education grants that help support evidence-based programs across our communities.

This Domestic Violence Awareness Month, I am standing with survivors as we push for a future free from violence, fear, and abuse.

Everyone deserves to feel safe in their home, relationships, and community. Know that you have options and you are not alone. Free, confidential help is available at https://t.co/OP6sXLGLi0 or call 800-799-SAFE.

I was deeply humbled to be recognized by @ERA_NC for my support of the House resolution which recognizes the ERA as ratified by the required 38 states needed for it to become law.

Congress must recognize the Equal Rights Amendment and take steps to end discrimination on the basis of sex.

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
